Pool Leak Detection & Repair in Plano, TX Mr. Pool Leak Repair provides professional pool leak detection and repair services throughout Plano, Texas. We help homeowners in one of the DFW metroplex’s largest and most established suburbs protect their pools from the challenging soil conditions that affect properties across North Texas. Schedule Your Leak Detection Now 469-936-4331 Expert staff verified by Built To Last Our Repair Warranties Every repair includes a written warranty — some of the strongest in Plano, Texas * Lifetime Warranty on Structural Crack Repairs 5 Year Warranty on Pipe Repairs 6 Year Warranty on Seal Repairs Trust The Experts. Why Plano's Mature Neighborhoods Face Unique Pool Challenges Plano sits at the heart of Collin County, approximately 20 miles north of downtown Dallas. With a population exceeding 290,000, Plano has grown from a farming community into a major employment center and one of the most desirable places to live in Texas. The city consistently ranks among the best places to live in America, thanks to its excellent schools, thriving job market, and diverse neighborhoods. From the luxury estates of Willow Bend and Gleneagles to established neighborhoods like Prestonwood and the modern developments near Legacy, Plano’s pools span decades of construction—and all of them contend with North Texas’s challenging soil. According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, the area covering Dallas through Collin County contains over 50% clay content—among the highest in the country. This expansive clay soil can exert up to 15,000 pounds per square foot of pressure on structures as it expands when wet and contracts when dry. FEMA estimates this type of soil movement causes over $7 billion in damage annually across the nation. For Plano pool owners, the consequences are significant. The American Society of Civil Engineers reports that nearly one quarter of all homes in the U.S. have foundation damage from expansive soils—and pools face identical forces. Older pools that have experienced decades of seasonal soil expansion and contraction are particularly vulnerable to shell cracks, separated plumbing, and equipment failures. Pool Tile Repair Loose or broken tiles? We repair or replace them so your pool stays safe, watertight, and beautiful. Pool Foundation Repair Cracks or sinking around your pool? We stabilize and repair foundations to protect your structure long-term. Pool Skimmer Repair Leaks or poor circulation at the skimmer? We reseal or replace skimmers so your system runs efficiently. Dye Test Need confirmation of a leak? Our non-invasive dye test pinpoints even the smallest cracks or gaps. Concrete Pool Deck Uneven or sinking deck? We level and reinforce concrete to keep your pool area safe and looking sharp. How It Works Book Your Inspection Call or request service online. We Find the Leak Using advanced detection methods. We Fix It & Guarantee It Backed by industry-leading warranties. Book Leak Detection Why Choose Us Why Frisco Homeowners Choose Mr. Pool Leak Repair Choosing the right pool repair company makes all the difference. Here’s why homeowners choose us again and again Fast scheduling and on-time arrival Accurate detection with advanced tools Repairs that last — backed by written warranties Licensed & insured technicians High satisfaction and 5-star reviews across DFW Book Leak Detection Warning Signs Your Frisco Pool May Have a Leak Not sure if your pool is leaking or just evaporating? Some water loss is normal in Texas heat, but watch for these warning signs: Water level dropping more than ¼ inch per day Needing to add water more than once per week Cracks appearing in the pool deck or coping Wet or soggy areas in your yard near the pool Algae growth despite proper chemical maintenance Increased water bills without explanation Air bubbles in the return lines Pool equipment losing prime frequently If you’re experiencing any of these issues, don’t delay. What starts as a small leak can quickly become a major structural problem—affecting your pool, your deck, and potentially your home’s foundation. from minor fixes to major overhauls We’re a full-service pool leak detection and repair company, equipped to handle all your pool repair needs. Contact Us Today FAq’s Frequently Asked Questions My Plano home was built in the 1980s. Should I be concerned about my pool? Pools that have experienced 30-40 years of soil expansion and contraction cycles have been under significant stress. While many hold up well, it’s wise to have an inspection if you notice any warning signs. Older pools in Plano’s established neighborhoods often develop leaks at connection points where the plumbing meets the pool shell. How do I know if my pool is leaking or just evaporating? In Plano’s climate, pools typically lose about ¼ inch of water per day to evaporation during hot summer months. If you’re losing more than that, or if water loss continues at similar rates during cooler weather, you likely have a leak. The bucket test can help: place a bucket of pool water on your steps and compare water levels after 24 hours. Are tree roots a concern in Plano's older neighborhoods? Yes, particularly in established areas with mature trees. Large trees near pools can send roots into plumbing lines or even damage pool shells over time. Our detection equipment can identify root-related damage. How do you find a hidden leak in a pool? There are several reliable technologies for locating leaks, including: Pressure testing Dye testing Electronic listening devices Ground probing While these tools are essential, experience is everything . We’re often called in after other companies have failed to find the leak — even using the same tools. Our method, called the “ process of elimination leak detection method,” consistently delivers accurate results. Can a pool leak cause structural damage to my property? Yes, absolutely. Unrepaired leaks can: Wash away soil Weaken your pool structure Crack concrete and foundations Cause underground plumbing damage That’s why pool crack repairs are a major industry . If not addressed early, the damage can escalate and require: Steel or Teflon staples Epoxy injections Torch staples Steel pier foundation repair In extreme cases, complete pool removal At Mr. Pool Leak Repair, we’re more than just a leak detection service — we’re a full-service repair company . We partner with engineers to ensure cracked pools are repaired the right way the first time. We’ve seen too many failed repairs from misdiagnosed cracks. In fact, pool staples have a 50% failure rate , which is why we rarely recommend them as a first option. Get Your Plano Pool Leak Fixed Today Stop watching your water disappear—and stop worrying about what damage it might be causing beneath the surface. The sooner you address a leak, the less damage it causes. Call today to learn more about how we can help you stop your pool from leaking.
